title: Paul McCartney live: Folsom Field, Boulder | 1993
content:
Paul McCartney performed at Folsom Field in Boulder, Colorado, USA, on 26 May 1993.

It was the 28th night of the New World Tour, which lasted for 77 dates across 19 countries between February and December 1993. The show was seen by 37,245 fans.

‘Hotel In Benidorm’ from the soundcheck, and ‘Let Me Roll It’, ‘Peace In The Neighbourhood’, ‘Michelle’, ‘Biker Like An Icon’, ‘Penny Lane’ and ‘Live And Let Die’ from the concert, appear on the 1990 live album Paul Is Live.

McCartney’s band was Linda McCartney on vocals, keyboards, and percussion; Hamish Stuart on guitar, bass guitar, and vocals; Robbie McIntosh on guitar and vocals; Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens on keyboards and vocals; and Blair Cunningham on drums and percussion.
